HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement, June 7, 2011
Employee: Richard Roe. He assigns to Harbor Labs, Inc. all inventions he makes
during his service that relate to its business.
He keeps the company's confidential information in confidence during and after his
service.
Exhibit A, prior inventions left out of this assignment: the shift-matching
scheduling prototype written in November 2010.
Signed: Richard Roe.
